name: Zen Koans
description: Quiet, and in no hurry to answer

ja.description: 静かで、答えを急がない

verbs: The log knows nothing of the log
When you find it, you were it
What was your build before this
Not the code, not the coder
Wash your bowl. Then read it
The path is the stack trace
Speak, and the cache is stale
The gate has no lock at all
